description: One $2,500 award for the child or spouse of an active-duty service member or veteran, studying a STEM discipline.
eligibility_text: Must be the child or spouse of an active-duty U.S. Armed Forces service member or a Veteran. Undergraduates must be in their sophomore, junior, or senior year; graduate students must be pursuing a Master's degree. Must be enrolled at an accredited community college or four-year college/university. Maintain a minimum 3.0 unweighted GPA. Must be majoring in a STEM-related discipline aligned with the mission of AFCEA.
notes: Split out of the retired 'afcea-stem-scholarship' umbrella on 2026-09-19. The umbrella averaged 13 named awards into eligibility true of none of them. Restricted to a military dependent or spouse, which the umbrella did not record. Page status on 2026-09-19: 'Applications closed!'. The page publishes no application deadline; 'no later than May 1, 2026' is the mailed-documents date for the closed cycle, recorded as cycle.deadline_month 5.

essay_prompts: A brief essay (250 words or less) describing financial need.

title: AFCEA iWorks Scholarship
